First, determine the total number of classes Judy teaches in a week.

- Weekdays: \(5\) days \(\times\) \(5\) classes per day \(= 25\) classes  
- Saturday: \(8\) classes  

\[
\text{Total classes per week}=25+8=33
\]

Each class has \(15\) students, and each student pays \(\$15.00\).

\[
\text{Revenue per class}=15\ \text{students}\times \$15 = \$225
\]

Now multiply the revenue per class by the total number of classes:

\[
\text{Weekly earnings}=33\ \text{classes}\times \$225 = \$7{,}425
\]

\[
\boxed{\$7{,}425}
\]
